places.name: The back courtyard of the jail

quests.title: A Jailer Would Be Enough
quests.objective: Go to He Jin's residence, on the main street west of the palace. The council is already sitting.
quests.objective_zh: 前往何进府，在宫城西边的大街上。众官已在议事。

quests.title: The Jiade Gate
quests.objective: Go to the Jiade Gate of the palace, at the north side of the main street.
quests.objective_zh: 前往宫城的嘉德门，在大街北侧。

quests.title: The Palace Burns
quests.objective: Get through the burning palace to Cuihua Tower, at its north-west corner.
quests.objective_zh: 穿过起火的宫城，到西北角的翠花楼。

quests.title: The Fireflies
quests.objective: Follow the fireflies up from the river to a farm.
quests.objective_zh: 跟着流萤，从河边往上，走到一座庄院。

quests.title: To Protect Us, or to Seize Us?
quests.objective: Go out to the road back to the capital, south of the farm.
quests.objective_zh: 走到庄南回京的路上。

quests.title: The Wenming Garden
quests.objective: Go to the banquet in the Wenming Garden, beside the palace.
quests.objective_zh: 前往宫城旁温明园的宴席。

quests.title: Lü Bu at the Front
quests.objective: Go to Dong Zhuo's tent.
quests.objective_zh: 前往董卓帐中。

quests.title: The Gifts
quests.objective: Collect the gifts: Red Hare from the stables, the gold from the paymaster.

gate.objective: Fetch Red Hare from the stable master, at the stables on the field side of the camp.
gate.objective_zh: 到营寨临原野一侧的马厩，向马夫牵出赤兔马。

quests.objective_zh: 收齐礼物：到马厩牵赤兔，到支应帐取金珠。

quests.title: An Old Friend
quests.objective: Take the gifts to Lü Bu's tent, in Ding Yuan's camp to the west.

gate.objective: Fetch the gold, the pearls and the jade belt from the paymaster's tent, just east of the Grand Preceptor's.
gate.objective_zh: 到太师帐东边不远的支应帐，取黄金、明珠与玉带。

quests.objective_zh: 把礼物送到西边丁原营中的吕布帐。

quests.title: The Second Watch
quests.objective: Go to Ding Yuan's tent.
quests.objective_zh: 前往丁原帐。

quests.title: Your Sword Is Sharp, and So Is Mine
quests.objective: Go to the Secretariat, in the palace behind the Qingsuo Gate.
quests.objective_zh: 前往省台，在青琐门内的宫中。

quests.title: The Jiade Hall
quests.objective: Go to the Jiade Hall, in the palace behind the Qingsuo Gate.
quests.objective_zh: 前往嘉德殿，在青琐门内的宫中。

quests.title: The Swallows
quests.objective: Walk the main street east towards the gate.
quests.objective_zh: 沿大街往东，朝城门走。

quests.title: Wu Fu
quests.objective: Go to the gallery in the palace, east of the inner court.
quests.objective_zh: 前往宫中阁下，在内庭东边。

quests.title: The False Birthday
quests.objective: Go to Wang Yun's house, on the main street beside He Jin's.
quests.objective_zh: 前往王允宅，在大街上何进府隔壁。

quests.title: The Mirror
quests.objective: Go to the Chancellor's residence, south of the palace, and find him in the small pavilion.
quests.objective_zh: 前往宫城南边的相府，到小阁中见董卓。

quests.title: The East Gate
quests.objective: Ride for the East Gate, at the end of the main street.
quests.objective_zh: 驰向东门，就在大街尽头。

quests.title: Zhongmou
quests.objective: Ride on east to the pass at Zhongmou.
quests.objective_zh: 往东骑到中牟关。

quests.title: The Back Courtyard
quests.objective: The jail's back courtyard.
quests.objective_zh: 县狱后院。

quests.title: Lü Boshe
quests.objective: Go to Lü Boshe's farm, in the walled yard north of the road.
quests.objective_zh: 前往吕伯奢庄，在大路北边的院落里。

quests.title: The Inn
quests.objective: Go into the roadside inn.
quests.objective_zh: 进路边客店。

quests.title: Wei Hong
quests.objective: Go to Wei Hong's mansion, on the road east of your father's house.
quests.objective_zh: 前往卫弘宅，在你父亲家东边的路上。

quests.title: The White Banner
quests.objective: Take Wei Hong's fortune to the drilling ground, south of the road.
quests.objective_zh: 把卫弘的家资送到大路南边的校场。
